pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Lo! man is a state of loss
Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages)
Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy
